html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN" class="theme-botanical theme-envelope"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><meta name="author" content="九一"><title>___JIUYI_HOME_title___ · 蓝花来信</title><style>@font-face{font-family:OpeningSong;src:url('___JIUYI_ASSET___5f912b8ae3c7967a7e4f.woff2') format('woff2');font-weight:400;font-display:swap}
:root{color-scheme:light;--paper:#fff;--ink:#303130;--muted:#73756f;--rule:#9a9c95;--faint:#d7d8d3;--outside:#f7f7f6}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{background:var(--outside);scroll-behavior:auto}
body{margin:0;color:var(--ink);font:15px/1.8 OpeningSong,'Songti SC',serif;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
h1,h2,h3,p,figure,dl,dd{margin:0}
h1,h2,h3{font-weight:400}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button,input,textarea{font:inherit}
a,button,summary,input,textarea{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:#c9cbd533}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,summary:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid currentColor;outline-offset:5px}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
svg{display:block;max-width:100%}
.asset-definitions{position:absolute;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.home-shell{width:min(100% - 40px,760px);margin:24px auto 32px}
.edition{background:var(--paper);container-type:inline-size;isolation:isolate}
.micro{font:9px/1.55 Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;letter-spacing:1.7px}
.arrow{font:22px/1 Georgia,serif;display:inline-block}
.cover-page{padding:26px 40px 24px;overflow:hidden}
.cover-masthead,.cover-colophon{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}
.cover-masthead{min-height:28px}
.cover-colophon{padding-top:26px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.cover-colophon .micro{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.2px}
.work-title{font-size:38px;letter-spacing:5px;line-height:1.55;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.work-title.is-long{font-size:28px;letter-spacing:2px}
.cover-subtitle,.page-subtitle{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8}
.cover-open{display:block;position:relative}
.cover-open-footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:54px;font-size:12px}
.cover-open-footer .micro{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1px}
.cover-open-footer .arrow{font-size:17px;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:10px}
.pages-view,.reader-view{padding:23px 36px 22px}
.page-topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;min-height:45px;font-size:12px}
.page-topbar>a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px}
.page-topbar>.micro{font-size:8px;text-align:right;max-width:54%}
.pages-title{padding:28px 0 27px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--rule)}
.pages-title .page-subtitle{margin-top:4px}
.credits{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.7fr 1fr 1.15fr;gap:16px;padding:19px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--faint)}
.credits>div{min-width:0}
.credits dt{font-size:10px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px}
.credits dd{font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.intro-column,.contents-column{min-width:0}
.section-label{margin-bottom:8px}
.intro-column h2,.contents-header h2{font-size:26px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:2px}
.story-intro{font-size:15px;line-height:2.05;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;letter-spacing:.3px}
.intro-column>.story-intro{margin-top:18px}
.contents-header{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding-bottom:20px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--rule)}
.contents-header h2{margin-top:7px}
.contents-count{font:italic 33px/1 Georgia,serif;color:var(--muted);padding-bottom:4px}
.opening-entry{border-bottom:1px solid var(--faint)}
.entry-link{display:block;padding:20px 0;min-height:100px;transition:opacity .18s}
.entry-link:hover{opacity:.7}
.entry-top{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--muted)}
.entry-number{font:italic 15px/1.4 Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:0}
.entry-link h3{font-size:23px;letter-spacing:1px;line-height:1.5;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin-top:9px}
.entry-summary{font-size:14px;line-height:1.95;margin-top:8px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.entry-bottom{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;margin-top:15px}
.entry-bottom>.arrow{font-size:21px}
.contents-footer{padding-top:18px;text-align:right;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px}
.empty-note{padding:25px 0;font-size:13px}
.edition-tail{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-top:32px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--faint)}
.edition-tail .micro{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.1px}
.print-mark{font:28px/1 Georgia,serif}
.reader-heading{padding:35px 0 0}
.reader-route{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--muted)}
.reader-heading h2{font-size:36px;line-height:1.65;letter-spacing:3px;margin:9px 0 20px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.reader-line{display:block;width:48px;height:2px;background:var(--ink)}
.reader-text{font-size:17px;line-height:2.1;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;padding:35px 0 55px;min-height:260px;letter-spacing:.6px}
.reader-footer{border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding:15px 0 10px}
.reader-footer>p{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}
.reader-footer nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-top:16px;font-size:12px}
.reader-footer nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px}
.sample-caption{font:11px/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin:22px 12px 14px}
.sample-editor{border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--paper);padding:0 18px;font:13px/1.7 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}
.sample-editor summary{min-height:48px;padding:13px 0;cursor:pointer}
.editor-body{padding:4px 0 18px}
.editor-body>p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:18px}
.editor-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.editor-field{display:grid;gap:5px;min-width:0}
.editor-field.wide{grid-column:1/-1}
.editor-field input,.editor-field textarea{width:100%;min-width:0;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:0;padding:9px;font-size:16px}
.editor-field textarea{min-height:86px;resize:vertical}
.editor-body h3{font:600 13px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;margin:20px 0 10px}
.noscript-note{text-align:center;font:13px/1.8 system-ui,sans-serif;padding:20px}
@media(max-width:480px){
 .home-shell{width:100%;margin:0 auto 24px}.cover-page{padding:22px 24px}.pages-view,.reader-view{padding:15px 22px 23px}
 .micro{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.4px}.cover-masthead{min-height:26px}.work-title{font-size:33px;letter-spacing:4px}.work-title.is-long{font-size:25px;letter-spacing:1.5px}
 .cover-subtitle,.page-subtitle{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px}.cover-colophon{font-size:10px;padding-top:20px}.cover-colophon .micro{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:1px}
 .page-topbar{font-size:11px}.page-topbar>.micro{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:1px}.pages-title{padding:22px 0}.credits{gap:12px;padding:17px 0}.credits dd{font-size:11px}.credits dt{font-size:9px;margin-bottom:4px}
 .story-intro{font-size:14px}.intro-column h2,.contents-header h2{font-size:24px}.entry-link h3{font-size:22px}.entry-summary{font-size:13px}.reader-text{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.3px}.reader-heading h2{font-size:32px}
 .sample-editor{margin-inline:16px}.sample-caption{font-size:10px}
}
@media(max-width:350px){.cover-page{padding-inline:18px}.pages-view,.reader-view{padding-inline:18px}.credits{gap:8px}.credits dd{font-size:10px}.page-topbar>.micro{max-width:48%}.work-title{font-size:29px;letter-spacing:3px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}

.theme-botanical .edition{border:1px solid #dbdcd8}
.theme-botanical .cover-page{padding-top:32px}
.theme-botanical .cover-masthead .micro{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--muted)}
.botanical-byline{text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:2px;margin-top:25px}
/* The two flower sections remain a single composition, with separate links. */
.botanical-stage{--art-height:500px;--band-height:102px;position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto auto auto;margin:24px auto 0;max-width:590px}
.botanical-entrance{display:block;min-width:0;border-radius:10px;transition:transform .55s ease,opacity .5s}
.botanical-half{position:relative;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.half-top{height:calc(var(--art-height) * .52)}
.half-bottom{height:calc(var(--art-height) * .48)}
.botanical-illustration{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:var(--art-height);max-width:none}
.half-bottom .botanical-illustration{top:calc(var(--art-height) * -.52)}
.botanical-entry-label{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px 15px;min-height:38px;padding:7px 4px;color:var(--ink);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1px;text-align:center}
.botanical-entry-label small{font:8px/1.6 Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:1.3px;color:var(--muted)}
.botanical-entrance:hover .botanical-entry-label>span,.botanical-entrance:focus-visible .botanical-entry-label>span{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px}
.botanical-entrance:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rule);outline-offset:4px}
.title-band{position:relative;min-width:0;min-height:var(--band-height);border-block:2px solid var(--rule);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;background:var(--paper);padding:10px 12px;transition:opacity .45s;text-align:center}
.title-band .work-title{max-width:100%;font-size:34px;letter-spacing:7px}.title-band .work-title.is-long{font-size:25px;letter-spacing:2px}
.title-band .cover-subtitle{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:3px;margin-top:5px}
.botanical-invitation{text-align:center;margin-top:24px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.9;letter-spacing:.6px;color:var(--muted)}
.theme-botanical .cover-colophon{padding-top:24px}
.theme-botanical .is-opening .bloom-about{transform:translateY(-42px);opacity:0}
.theme-botanical .is-opening .bloom-contents{transform:translateY(42px);opacity:0}
.theme-botanical .is-opening .title-band{opacity:0}

/* Independent introduction and directory pages. */
.theme-botanical .book-icon{width:21px;height:22px;flex:0 0 21px}
.theme-botanical .page-topbar>a{gap:8px}
.theme-botanical .pages-title{text-align:center;padding-top:29px;padding-bottom:25px;border-bottom-width:2px}
.theme-botanical .credits{padding:20px 0 22px}
.theme-botanical .about-layout,.theme-botanical .contents-layout{max-width:560px;margin-inline:auto;padding-top:28px}
.theme-botanical .intro-column{padding:10px 0 24px}
.theme-botanical .intro-column h2{font-size:23px}
.theme-botanical .story-intro{max-width:40em;margin-top:17px;font-size:16px;line-height:2.1}
.theme-botanical .contents-header{padding-bottom:18px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--rule)}
.theme-botanical .contents-hint{font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted);padding:13px 0 18px}
.theme-botanical .section-switch{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font-size:13px}
.theme-botanical .edition-tail{flex-wrap:wrap;border-top-width:1.5px;margin-top:28px}

/* Compact, rounded chapter cards retain the white paper palette. */
.theme-botanical .opening-list{display:grid;gap:12px}
.theme-botanical .opening-entry{border:0}
.theme-botanical .chapter-sheet{border:1.5px solid #a4a89f;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
.theme-botanical .chapter-tab{position:relative;display:block;list-style:none;min-height:100px;padding:12px 16px 10px;cursor:pointer;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.theme-botanical .chapter-tab::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.theme-botanical .chapter-tab:focus-visible{outline-offset:-5px;border-radius:10px}
.theme-botanical .chapter-folio{display:inline-block;margin-right:10px;font:italic 15px/1.4 Georgia,serif;color:#64695f}
.theme-botanical .entry-route{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.8px;color:#71766d}
.theme-botanical .chapter-tab h3{font-size:24px;letter-spacing:1px;line-height:1.4;margin:7px 0 0;padding-right:28px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.theme-botanical .fold-mark{display:none}
.theme-botanical .chapter-toggle{position:absolute;right:16px;top:46px;color:#686f62}
.theme-botanical .chapter-toggle>span{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;clip-path:inset(50%);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap}
.theme-botanical .chapter-toggle i{position:relative;display:block;width:15px;height:15px}
.theme-botanical .chapter-toggle i::before,.theme-botanical .chapter-toggle i::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:7px;left:2px;width:11px;height:1px;background:currentColor}
.theme-botanical .chapter-toggle i::after{transform:rotate(90deg);transition:transform .2s}
.theme-botanical .when-open{display:none}
.theme-botanical .chapter-sheet[open] .when-closed{display:none}
.theme-botanical .chapter-sheet[open] .when-open{display:inline}
.theme-botanical .chapter-sheet[open] .chapter-toggle i::after{transform:rotate(0deg)}
.theme-botanical .chapter-sheet[open]{background:#f7f8f5}
.theme-botanical .chapter-body{padding:0 16px 12px}
.theme-botanical .entry-summary{font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;letter-spacing:.1px;margin:0;padding:0 0 14px}
.theme-botanical .entry-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;max-width:156px;min-height:44px;margin-left:auto;padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid #9fa797;border-radius:8px;background:#e8ece3;color:#30372d;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}
.theme-botanical .entry-link:hover{opacity:1;background:#dfe6d9}
.theme-botanical .entry-link .book-icon{width:19px;height:20px;flex-basis:19px}
.theme-botanical .chapter-read-label{margin-left:auto;font:8px/1.3 Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:1px}
.theme-botanical .was-viewed .entry-link{background:#fff;color:#5e6856}

.theme-botanical .reading-leaf{margin-top:20px;padding:12px 0 10px;border-top:2px solid var(--rule)}
.theme-botanical .reader-heading{padding-top:20px}
.theme-botanical .leaf-end{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:25px}
.theme-botanical .leaf-end span{width:28px;height:1px;background:var(--rule)}
.theme-botanical .reader-footer nav a{gap:8px}
.theme-botanical .reader-footer nav a[data-next-opening]{padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid #a4a89f;border-radius:8px;background:#f7f8f5}
@media(max-width:480px){
 .theme-botanical .edition{border:0}.theme-botanical .cover-page{padding-top:23px}.botanical-byline{margin-top:21px}.botanical-stage{--art-height:370px;--band-height:85px;margin-top:20px}
 .title-band .work-title{font-size:30px;letter-spacing:5px}.title-band .work-title.is-long{font-size:23px}.title-band .cover-subtitle{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px}
 .botanical-entry-label{font-size:12px;gap:4px 12px}.botanical-entry-label small{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:1px}
 .botanical-invitation{margin-top:20px;font-size:10px}.theme-botanical .cover-colophon{padding-top:18px}
 .theme-botanical .story-intro{font-size:15px}.theme-botanical .about-layout,.theme-botanical .contents-layout{padding-top:24px}.theme-botanical .intro-column{padding:6px 0 20px}
 .theme-botanical .chapter-tab{min-height:94px;padding:11px 15px 10px}.theme-botanical .chapter-tab h3{font-size:22px}
 .theme-botanical .chapter-body{padding-inline:15px}.theme-botanical .entry-summary{font-size:14px}
}
@media(max-width:350px){.botanical-stage{--art-height:330px}.title-band .work-title{font-size:28px}.theme-botanical .edition-tail>.micro{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.8px}}

:root{--paper:#fff;--ink:#253d54;--muted:#78848b;--rule:#8b9fae;--faint:#dce2e5;--outside:#edf0f0;--blue:#153c5c}
.theme-envelope .edition{border-color:#d5dee2;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}
.theme-envelope .cover-page{padding:25px 32px 24px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 55% 46%,#f6f5f1,transparent 60%),#fff}
.theme-envelope .cover-masthead{border-bottom:1px solid #d9e0e4;padding-bottom:13px}
.theme-envelope .cover-masthead .micro{font-size:9px;color:#627989;letter-spacing:1.6px}
.envelope-heading{text-align:center;padding-top:28px}
.envelope-heading>.micro{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#718491}
.theme-envelope .envelope-heading .work-title{font-size:39px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:5px;margin-top:9px}
.theme-envelope .envelope-heading .work-title.is-long{font-size:28px;letter-spacing:2px}
.envelope-heading .cover-subtitle{font-size:12px;margin-top:5px;letter-spacing:3px}
/* Raster paper components share the same physical envelope proportions. */
.envelope-scene{position:relative;height:clamp(260px,75vw,365px);max-width:555px;margin:0 auto;perspective:1200px;transition:height 1.1s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,.24,1)}
.envelope-object{position:absolute;bottom:32px;left:5%;width:90%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:var(--pocket-ratio);isolation:isolate;transform:translateY(-8px) scale(1.02);transition:transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.22,.68,.24,1),opacity .4s}
.envelope-back{position:absolute;inset:1px;z-index:1;background:#314b5e;border:2px solid #eae4d8;border-radius:3px;box-shadow:0 14px 22px -16px #57483670,0 2px 3px #60564412}
.envelope-lid{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:var(--flap-height);z-index:8;transform-origin:50% 0;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .95s cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.22,1),z-index 0s .42s;pointer-events:none}
.lid-face{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden}
.paper-flap-button{display:block;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;appearance:none;opacity:1;cursor:pointer;pointer-events:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 2.5px 1.5px #5c4f3b38);transition:filter .2s}
.paper-flap-button>svg{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden}
.paper-flap-button:not(:disabled):hover{filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 2px #5c4f3b48)}
.paper-flap-button:focus-visible{outline:2px dotted #8d8575;outline-offset:7px}
.lid-inside{transform:rotateY(180deg);pointer-events:none}
.envelope-pocket{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:6;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 -1px .7px #5b514224)}
.envelope-insert{position:absolute;z-index:2;width:40%;height:190px;top:5px;left:8%;padding:16px 14px;border:1px solid #cec9ba;background:#fffdf5;box-shadow:0 1px 5px #173d5726;opacity:0;transform:translateY(38px) rotate(-3deg);transition:transform .95s .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),opacity .35s .35s}
.envelope-insert>span:first-child{display:block;font:7px/1.5 Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:1.2px;color:#8a9294}
.envelope-insert .insert-name{display:block;margin-top:13px;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:3px;line-height:1.8}
.envelope-insert i{display:block;margin-top:14px;width:70%;height:20px;border-block:1px solid #d5dddf}
.envelope-bouquet{position:absolute;z-index:3;width:77%;max-width:none;height:auto;left:12%;bottom:18px;overflow:visible;opacity:0;transform:translateY(65px) scale(.88);transform-origin:50% 90%;transition:transform 1.05s .34s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.22,1),opacity .4s .35s;pointer-events:none}
.bouquet-sway{transform-box:view-box;transform-origin:50% 92%}
.letters-ready .bouquet-sway{animation:bouquet-breeze 7.8s ease-in-out infinite}
.bouquet-paused .bouquet-sway{animation-play-state:paused}
@keyframes bouquet-breeze{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0deg) translateY(0)}28%{transform:rotate(-1.2deg) translateY(-3px)}63%{transform:rotate(1.05deg) translateY(-1px)}82%{transform:rotate(.35deg) translateY(-2px)}}
.envelope-hint{font-size:12px;text-align:center;line-height:1.8;color:#7c817f;letter-spacing:.8px;min-height:22px;margin-top:6px}
.envelope-open .envelope-scene{height:clamp(365px,117vw,650px)}
.envelope-open .envelope-object{transform:translateY(0) scale(.96)}
.envelope-open .envelope-lid{transform:rotateX(-180deg);z-index:1}
.envelope-open .paper-flap-button{pointer-events:none}
.envelope-open .envelope-insert{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-94px) rotate(-7deg)}
.envelope-open .envelope-bouquet{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}
.letter-links{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:15px;max-width:500px;margin:0 auto;max-height:0;overflow:hidden;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateY(-16px);transition:max-height .6s .82s,opacity .5s 1s,transform .6s 1s,margin .6s .82s,visibility 0s 1s}
